name: blueprint/open-data-snapshot
description: Keyless government and civic datasets as diffable snapshots: fetch, normalize, store, diff against the previous snapshot, summarize the change
ingredients: guardedFetch over keyless data APIs (USGS quakes is the canonical example)
recipe: fetch the dataset endpoint -> normalize to the stable shape (data-adapter recipe) -> store the snapshot -> diff against the previous snapshot and summarize the change
pitfalls: snapshots need stable record ids or the diff is noise
size caps from guardedFetch bound every snapshot
keep the raw snapshot AND the change note
